zen.text: Ob Nixilis is a cursed demon on Zendikar, where Nahiri implants a hedron in his forehead and strips him of his wings and his ability to planeswalk.

He wakes buried alive after Nissa takes Khalni Heart and collapses the cavern, recalls his failed plan to reignite his spark through a hedron network, and decides he must save Zendikar to buy time to rebuild his work.
At Sea Gate he locks his keystone hedron above the ring that traps Ulamog, and his spark returns; he then frees Ulamog, collapsing the network.

Calling Kozilek up from the ground, he fights Gideon and drowns him in muddy water, until Chandra, Gideon, Jace and Nissa attack together and Chandra's fire cyclone drives him off with a promise of revenge.

m15.text: Deep underground, Ob Nixilis broods over his two defeats, the first of which robbed him of his body and the second of his spark.
He recalls being drawn to Zendikar to purge a curse and being bound with a hedron by Nahiri, which stopped the curse but left him small and weak.
He hates Zendikar and sees Nahiri's face in every kor, and he studies the hedrons for centuries, luring planeswalkers and hoping one will extract the one he carries.

Reaching a glowing source in the depths, he takes a flower of green and gold power, laughing, and says that heroes coming to fight the Eldrazi will need what he knows, because his spark is within reach.

bfz.text: Ob Nixilis seeks a way off Zendikar, but at Bala Ged Nissa bests him, removes the Khalni Heart to safety and leaves the demon seething underground.
At Tazeem he knocks the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his spark, destroying the network that held Ulamog.
He calls Kozilek from beneath the surface, so that two titans are rampaging, and he betrays the defenders at Sea Gate.
He defeats Nissa, breaks Jace's cheekbone, drowns Gideon, and tortures his three captives until Chandra frees them and scares him away from Zendikar.

ogw.text: Ob Nixilis had prepared for every eventuality except Chandra Nalaar, who surprises him.
Jace and Nissa imprison Ulamog in a hedron network at Sea Gate on Ugin's advice, but Ob Nixilis's interference makes it fail and he calls Kozilek to join Ulamog.
He traps Gideon, Jace and Nissa while seeking the Eldrazi's power, and Chandra frees them and they drive him from Zendikar.
They swear an oath that creates the Gatewatch.

snc.text: On New Capenna Ob Nixilis is the Adversary, who infiltrates the crime families by offering Halo in exchange for loyalty and decides to seize the plane by usurping its hidden power networks.
On the night of the Cabaretti Crescendo he has his agents attack all five families and kills Xander himself at the Maestro Museum, after Xander's own former assassins turn on him.
Learning that the Font escaped the Crescendo and that Xander played him even from beyond the grave, Ob Nixilis vows to find it and orders the families' heads.

He pursues Elspeth, Vivien and Giada to a Park Heights cathedral, where Giada sacrifices herself and becomes the Halo that gives Elspeth Luxior, which wounds him badly enough that he planeswalks away; he later sits out the New Phyrexian Invasion, then loses his spark and is stranded on New Capenna.

j22.text: Trapped on Ravnica with no affection for either side, Ob Nixilis seeks gratification in random acts of torment.
